label: Resolve ambiguity
hint: See the preferred order and a date with only one valid month.
paragraphs: A numeric date can mean different things in different places. The parser starts with a preferred date order, then checks which readings can form a valid date.
Here, 03/04/2026 means 3 April. In 04/13/2026, 13 cannot be a month, so the parser recognizes 13 April instead. The written result lets you check what was understood.
